items.title: Filtered colimits of K-flat complexes are K-flat
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a colimit of a system of K-flat complexes, and more generally any filtered colimit of K-flat complexes, is again K-flat. The proof uses that taking termwise colimits commutes with forming the total tensor product against a fixed complex, so that the total complexes computing the tensor product against the colimit are colimits of the corresponding total complexes for the approximating complexes. Since filtered colimits are exact, a quasi-isomorphism computing the derived tensor product for each approximation produces one for the colimit.
